into the `<Title>/` folder next to it, each page's files into `<Title>/assets/`. Links
between exported pages are relative, other page links absolute. At most 500 pages and
200 MiB uncompressed (413 otherwise).

members left the workspace is not one.

unread_count.description: Unread messages in the main list, written by other members.

name.description: A domain such as `example.com`; Unicode names are stored as A-labels.

body.description:

quote.description: The selected text the thread is about (trimmed, at most 1000 characters are kept).

overrides.description: The admin's edits of the proposed local parts.

parent_task_id.description: Create the task as a sub-issue of this task.

url.description: Same-origin image path. The image of an id never changes.

sub_issues.description: Optional in stored and received states (default `nested`).

code.description: A code the authenticator app shows now.

name.description: What the user calls it, e.g. "MacBook" or "YubiKey".

created_at.description: When the original message was sent.

InstanceMailView.description: Mail on this installation; the health card is `GET /api/v1/admin/mail`.

oneOf.description: `null` until a mail server is saved.

workspace_concurrency.description: For one workspace while another workspace has a job of the kind waiting.

kinds.description: Kinds left out keep their limits.

LinkPreview.description: What a URL shows as a card. Image URLs are always `https`.

large_image.description: The page asks for a wide image (`summary_large_image`).

video_url.description: The video of a post, as an `mp4` on X's video host. `image_url` is its poster.

test_domains.description: The verified domains of all workspaces, by name.

workspace_providers_enabled.description: Workspace admins may set up their own mail providers.

content_type.description: The type detected from the bytes (served).

inline.description: An inline part (an image in the HTML body).

MailAuthResult.description: An SPF, DKIM or DMARC result.

MailAuthSummary.description: What the checks found when the message arrived.

aligned_domain.description: The `From` domain that DMARC proved (only when it passed).

MailBytes.description: Binary bodies in the API description.

MailCertView.description: The certificate the listener offers for `STARTTLS`.

covers_hostname.description: One of `names` matches the mail hostname.

names.description: DNS names of the certificate, lower case.

mailboxes.description: The mailboxes the caller reads, by name.

dmarc_policy.description: The `p=` of the domain's DMARC record at the last check.

grace_ends_at.description: Suspended domains only: mail is refused after this.

name.description: Normalized: lower case, IDNA A-labels (`xn--…`), no trailing dot.

oneOf.description: The provider that receives the domain's mail; `null`: this server's SMTP listener.

records.description: The records to publish, each with its status at the last check.

suspended_at.description: When the TXT record of a verified domain was found missing.

mailbox_id.description: A mailbox of the workspace, or `null` to refuse unknown addresses.

enabled.description: `false` refuses all mail for the domain.

MailDomainRoute.description: The provider a domain is routed to.

instance.description: An instance provider (set up by the root user).

bridge_peers.description: Connections that came from a Docker bridge gateway since the start.

can_manage.description: The caller manages mail (domains, mailboxes, labels).

external.description: Came from outside the workspace into a thread that started inside it.

load_images_default.description: Remote images load at once: the caller chose it for this sender and DMARC passed.

lookalike_member.description:

sender.description: The `Sender` address, when it differs from `From`.

warning.description: Why the message shows as plain text only (`parse_failed`, `limit`).

MailNamePattern.description: How **Create a mailbox for each member** names the addresses.

MailPerson.description: A name and an address from a mail header.

worker_script.description: Cloudflare: the Email Worker to paste.

domain_count.description: Domains routed to it, of every workspace.

generated_secrets.description: The secrets Orbit made (Cloudflare, Postmark), in the create response only.

last_error.description: The last failed delivery, cleared by the next good one.

secrets_set.description: The names of the secrets that are set (never their values).

oneOf.description: `null` for an instance provider listed to a workspace.

peer_ip.description: The sender's address as the listener saw it (after PROXY v2).

oneOf.description: `null` when the message came without `STARTTLS` (or before it arrived).

cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last one.

from.description: The distinct senders, first sender first (at most 5).

has_attachments.description: A message has an attachment that is not an inline image.

unread.description: A message arrived after the caller last read the thread.

Frame it in a sandboxed iframe (`allow-scripts allow-popups
allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox`, never `allow-same-origin`).

load_images.description: Rewrite remote images to the image proxy (**Load images**); otherwise they are removed.

local_part.description: Lower case, without a `+tag`; mail to `local+anything@` arrives here too.

avatar_url.description: The member's profile picture; absent while they have none.

can_change_role.description: Whether the caller may change this member's role.

can_remove.description: Whether the caller may remove this member (for the caller's own row: leave).

suspended_at.description: Set while the user's account is suspended (they cannot sign in or be notified).

(`mentions` is empty whatever the body says) and cannot be edited.

The sticker the message was sent with; its body may be empty. The id stays when the
sticker is deleted.

With `parent_id: null`: `true` moves the page into the caller's private space, `false`

path_style.description: `endpoint/bucket/key` URLs (MinIO and most self-hosted servers) instead of `bucket.endpoint/key`.

prefix.description: Key prefix in the bucket, for example `orbit`. Empty: the bucket root.

secret_access_key.description: Absent or empty: keep the saved secret key.

S3View.description: The saved bucket. The secret key is never returned.

prefix.description: Key prefix in the bucket; empty for the bucket root.

can_change_visibility.description: Whether the caller may change who sees this view.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may PATCH/DELETE this view.

favorite_position.description: The caller's sidebar position for this view; null when not a favorite.

icon.description: Icon name from the web app's icon set.

is_favorite.description: Whether the caller has favorited this view.

oneOf.description: Null when the stored state no longer parses; `state_error` then says why.

ranges.description: `[start, end)` offsets in `message.body` to highlight, in UTF-16 code units.

cursor.description: Null when there is nothing older.

code.description: The 6-digit code of the authenticator app, or a recovery code.

workspace_providers_enabled.description: Absent: unchanged. Off stops new workspace providers; existing ones keep receiving.

ShortcutsBody.description:
Keyboard shortcut overrides: command id -> keys, or null for "no shortcut".
The web app owns the command ids and the key notation; the server only bounds the size.

ShowCompleted.description: Which tasks in a done category (completed, cancelled, duplicate) stay visible.

password.description: Absent: keep the saved password. Empty: remove it. Otherwise: the new password.

password_set.description: A password is saved. The password itself is never returned.

password.description: The current password: a new passkey is a new way into the account.

url.description: Same-origin image path. The image of an id never changes.

attachments_in_s3.description: New attachment files go to the bucket and existing ones move there. Off: they move back to this server.

backups_in_s3.description: New backups are uploaded to the bucket.

attachments_in_s3.description: New attachment files go to the bucket; existing ones move there in the background.

backups_in_s3.description: New backups are uploaded to the bucket instead of kept on this server.

files_to_move.description: Attachment files still waiting to move between this server's disk and the bucket.

oneOf.description: The last run of "Compress images"; `null` when this server cannot compress.

move_error.description: Why moving files stopped last time. Orbit retries every ten minutes.

oneOf.description: `null` until a bucket is saved.

SubIssuesDisplay.description:
How a view shows sub-issues. `nested` and `flat` only change the client; `hidden` lists
top-level tasks only (`POST /tasks/query` `sub_issues`).

TaskBulkResponse.description: `POST /tasks/bulk`: the updated tasks (no further pages) plus the automation's changes.

path.description:
JSON path of the first invalid filter node, e.g. `filter.children[2].value`. Only set
for `invalid_filter`.

filter.description: The complete filter tree, including any preset and project scope.

parent_task_id.description: Only direct children of this task.

sub_issues.description: The view's sub-issue display; `hidden` returns top-level tasks only (default `nested`).

blocked.description: True while at least one live task that is not completed, cancelled or a duplicate blocks it.

collab_epoch.description: Epoch of the description's co-editing document (`/tasks/{id}/collab?epoch=`).

description.description: Markdown copy of `description_json` (search, MCP, GitHub, API clients).

description_json.description:
BlockNote blocks, the description's source; null for a task written before rich text
(only `description` exists then) and in task lists (read the task for it).

oneOf.description: The task this one duplicates; null when it is not a duplicate or its target is in the trash.

number.description:
Per-project sequence number: the task's identifier is `{project key}-{number}`, e.g.
`ENG-12`. Reassigned when the task moves to another project; never reused.

oneOf.description: The parent while it is visible (live, in a live project); null otherwise.

parent_task_id.description: The direct parent; null for top-level tasks.

sub_issue_closed_count.description: Direct live children in a completed, cancelled or duplicate status.

trashed_descendant_count.description: Task trash only: descendants trashed together with this task (restored with it).

TaskRef.description:
A task reference small enough to embed; clients build the display identifier
(`{project_key}-{number}`) themselves.

number.description: The task's number in that project.

project_key.description: The key of the task's (live) project, e.g. `ORB`.

direction.description: Outgoing when the viewed task is the relation's source (the blocker or the duplicate).

description.description: Markdown. Send `description_json` instead for rich text (not both).

description_json.description: The description as BlockNote blocks; its markdown copy becomes `description`.

duplicate_of_id.description: Absent: unchanged. A task id: mark this task as a duplicate of it. `null`: unmark.

parent_task_id.description: Absent: unchanged. A task id: make this task its sub-issue. `null`: detach.

TaskUpdateResponse.description:
`POST /tasks` and `PATCH /tasks/{id}`: the task plus the tasks the sub-issue automation
changed.

is_default.description: True for the workspace's first teamspace by position; new root pages go there by default.

sent.description: How many of the user's browsers took the push.

TextRange.description:
A span of a string in UTF-16 code units (JavaScript string indices): `start` inclusive, `end`
exclusive.

oneOf.description: Null until the caller follows the thread or has read it.

ThreadStateRecord.description: The caller's state in one thread.

otpauth_url.description: The `otpauth://` URL the QR code holds.

qr_code.description: The QR code as a PNG `data:` URL.

secret.description: The secret in base32, for apps that cannot scan the QR code.

TrashedPage.description: A page trashed directly; its descendants trashed with it are restored together.

can_purge.description: Whether the caller may delete this page forever.

private.description: True when the page is in the caller's private space.

teamspace_id.description: `null` for a page in the caller's private space.

TwoFactorChallenge.description: The answer to a right password when the account has two-factor sign-in on.

two_factor_token.description: Send it with the code to `/api/v1/auth/login/two-factor` within five minutes.

TwoFactorStatus.description: What the Security page shows about the account's sign-in methods.

totp_enabled.description: Sign-in asks for an authenticator app code after the password.

oneOf.description: Replaces every secret of the provider.

UpdateMailThreadBody.description: A change to a thread; absent fields keep their value.

oneOf.description: Moving to trash keeps the folder to restore; moving out of trash restores it there.

restore.description:
Moves a trashed thread back to the folder it came from (the inbox when unknown). Not
together with `folder`.

UpdateMailThreadsBody.description: The same change for many threads.

ids.description: 1–100 thread ids. Threads the caller does not read are left alone.

title.description: The optional parts: absent leaves the part as it is, an empty text removes it.

UserStatus.description: A user's presence and custom status; the same in every workspace.

emoji.description: The emoji of the custom status.

expires_at.description: When the custom status ends; the presence stays.

text.description: The text of the custom status.

icon.description: Icon name: ASCII letters, digits, `-` or `_`, up to 64 bytes.

view_ids.description: Every view the caller has favorited in this workspace, in the new order.

oneOf.description: Null when the stored state no longer parses; `state_error` then says why.

ViewState.description: Filter and display options shared by saved views and per-page preferences.

oneOf.description: Only the view's owner may change this.

permissions.description: What the caller's role may do in this workspace.

WorkspaceStorage.description: How many bytes of files a workspace stores, and its quota.

used_bytes.description:
Each stored file once, however often it is attached. A deleted file stops counting about a day after its
last reference goes (trashed tasks, pages and messages keep their files until the trash is emptied).
